'''Carbos Thirteen''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] around which a space battle between [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Nek Bwua'tu]] and the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] and [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] fleets of the [[Confederation]] was conducted during the weeks that followed the [[Second Battle of Fondor]]. Admiral Bwua'tu managed to ensnare both opposing fleets near the planet, eliminating a large percentage of the warships that supported the Confederation.
